newsitem.title: GERMANY: Welteke says welcomes dollar normalisation.
newsitem.headline: Welteke says welcomes dollar normalisation.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Ernst Welteke said on Wednesday he welcomed the rise of the dollar, which has climbed from all-time lows to 34-month highs, but said normalisation had now taken place.
"Welteke welcomes the normalisation of the dollar, but says the process is now complete," a spokesman for Welteke, who is also president of the state bank of Hesse, told Reuters.

The spokesman was replying to Reuters' queries after a report that Welteke had said that a dollar level between 1.70 marks and 1.75 marks would not pose a major danger of imported inflation to Germany.
Welteke said in the report that the dollar is moving around its long-term average and that the development of the currency has gone in the right direction and does not have to go further.
The dollar stood at 1.6915/22 marks in midday trade on Wednesday.
